name: clear-monorepo
description: Settlement-only blockchain protocol for verifiable cross-border carbon registry transfers

scripts.bootstrap: CI=true pnpm install && pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm run build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @clear/shared run build && pnpm --filter @clear/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @clear/registry-hub run build && pnpm --filter @clear/frontend-app run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @clear/contracts run lint && pnpm --filter @clear/registry-hub run lint && pnpm --filter @clear/frontend-app run lint
scripts.infra:up: bash scripts/prepare-besu-validators.sh && bash scripts/compose.sh up -d postgres besu-node-1 besu-node-2 besu-node-3 blockscout-db blockscout ipfs graph-node
scripts.infra:reset: bash scripts/compose.sh down -v --remove-orphans && rm -rf infra/besu/validators/validator-1/data infra/besu/validators/validator-2/data infra/besu/validators/validator-3/data
scripts.subgraph:deploy: pnpm --filter @clear/subgraph run create-local || true && pnpm --filter @clear/subgraph run deploy-local
scripts.demo:fresh: pnpm run infra:reset && pnpm run demo:prepare && pnpm run app:dev
scripts.demo: pnpm run demo:prepare && pnpm run app:dev
